title: Sentiment Analysis: Automatically Detecting Valence, Emotions, and Other Affectual States from Text

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that evaluates differences in emotionality scores assigned by machine learning systems to near-identical sentences containing African American versus European American names.

Reviewing literature that measures differences in sentiment analysis accuracy on texts written by different genders, as well as discrepancies in emotionality scores assigned to sentences mentioning men versus women.
Reviewing literature that examines sentiment resources and word embeddings to compare the sentiment polarities associated with old-age-related terms versus youth-related terms.
